DiscouragedFunctionConfig.description:
Options for the `discouraged-function` rule.

`functions` replaces the built-in deny-list, while `extend-functions` adds
entries or overrides their suggestions. Setting `functions = {}` silences
the rule without adding it to `ignore`.

extend-functions.description:
Entries added on top of `functions`. An entry with the same name wins,
so a project can reword a built-in suggestion without restating the map.

default.cd: use the `cd(f, dir)` do-block form so the working directory is restored
default.exit: let the caller decide when the process ends
default.pointer_from_objref: prefer a safe alternative; the caller must guarantee the pointer stays valid
default.unsafe_load: prefer a safe alternative; the caller must guarantee the pointer stays valid
default.unsafe_pointer_to_objref: prefer a safe alternative; the caller must guarantee the pointer stays valid
default.unsafe_store!: prefer a safe alternative; the caller must guarantee the pointer stays valid
default.unsafe_string: prefer a safe alternative; the caller must guarantee the pointer stays valid
default.unsafe_wrap: prefer a safe alternative; the caller must guarantee the pointer stays valid

functions.description:
Function name to diagnostic suggestion. Defaults to the built-in
deny-list; setting it replaces that set wholesale.

indent-width.description: Spaces per indentation level. Defaults to 4.

indent_width.description: Deprecated snake_case alias for `indent-width`, still accepted with a warning.

line_width.description: Deprecated snake_case alias for `line-width`, still accepted with a warning.

oneOf.description: Detect per file from the source; default `\n` when none is present.

rules.description: Per-rule option tables, keyed by configurable rule ID.

select.description: When set, run only these rule IDs.

RulesConfig.description:
Options for configurable lint rules under `[lint.rules]`.

Each table name is the rule's public ID. Rules without tunable options have
no table, and unknown rule tables or option names are rejected.

Severity.description: Severity assigned to a lint diagnostic.

oneOf.description: A correctness failure that should stop the workflow.
A likely problem that deserves attention.
Informational guidance that does not indicate a failure.

description: Schema for fatou.toml. Generated from Fatou's configuration types; do not hand-edit—run `UPDATE_EXPECTED=1 cargo test config_schema` instead.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style patterns to exclude from file discovery.

format.description: Formatter settings. Omitted values use Fatou's built-in defaults.

lint.description: Linter selection, severity, and per-rule settings.
